description: Na₆Mn₃(PO₄)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (2.25 Å) and one longer (2.32 Å) Na-O bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.50 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.65 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.68 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.72 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.71 Å. There are three inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-67°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.45 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra and corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-67°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.34 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-64°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.37 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-64°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.58 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-50°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-66°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.59 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-53°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.58 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMn₂P tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaMn₂P tetrahedra. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Mn, and one P atom to form distorted ONaMn₂P tetrahedra that share corners with four ONaMn₂P tetrahedra and  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MnP trigonal pyramid. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂MnP trigonal pyramids.
